text:
Renee Cole: hitting onboarding friction with the new next-mini-starter + LangChain sample. Followed README, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, but deployed ISR pages intermittently return 401s. JS SDK doesn't auto-retry. Anyone seen this? cc @Diego

Diego Alvarez: Is that a project key or an ephemeral session token? If infra rotates keys we should see an x-rw-exp header on the upstream response.

Renee Cole: Project key for staging. Example API handler from the starter:
```js
// pages/api/chat.js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk-js'
const client = createClient(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const r = await client.chat({ model: 'redwood/mini', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: req.body.q }] })
  res.status(200).json(r)
}
```

Mina Patel: Module-scoped client + serverless cold start can keep stale credentials across invocations. Python SDK added rotation-watch logic; JS parity is still pending. Workaround: create client inside handler or catch 401 and retry once after recreating the client.

Diego Alvarez: I can repro with a short-lived key simulator. The JS client currently treats 401 as terminal and doesn't inspect x-rw-exp. Quick fix: on 401, if x-rw-exp exists and is <= now + 20s, invalidate cached auth and retry once. I'll prototype.

Renee Cole: Logs show: 
```
2026-03-29T08:11:02Z WARN upstream 401 x-rw-error=invalid_api_key x-rw-exp=172
2026-03-29T08:11:02Z ERROR handler uncaught -> 500
```

Sdk Eng Bot: CI job devex/next-smoke triggered for branch fix/js-auth-retry (1/1) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Diego Alvarez: Draft PR up with single retry logic + unit tests that simulate rotation header. Adding a small Next smoke test to devex CI that runs the starter and simulates rotation.

QA Eng: Please add an e2e case that reproduces short-lived keys and asserts no leaked 401s to ISR pages. Also add a README note in the starter about instantiating the client per-request until JS SDK fully implements rotation refresh.

Mina Patel: I'll enable telemetry flag for the sample in staging so we can measure impact post-merge.

Renee Cole: After merging the branch to staging, verified onboarding flow and ISR pages stable. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
